verdicts.reason: A breaks the illustration apart: the white circle sits alone at the far left as a meaningless blob, and the rider is pasted bare onto the red on the right. The headline is shrunk to a tiny cluster near the centre and the 'Betty Williams' credit is unreadable. B keeps the rider inside its circle on the right and gives the headline a readable size at the left, but the attribution is stranded in the middle, away from its quote. It also leaves large dead red gaps on either side of the credit, so it needs regrouping before it ships.
